summary: Scheduled reports display times in UTC instead of the workspace timezone
description: Customers on non-UTC workspaces report that scheduled report timestamps are several hours off. Affects the emailed PDF and the in-app schedule view.

summary: Android app crashes on launch for some users after the 4.2 update
description: Intermittent crash-on-open on Android following the 4.2 release. Appears device/OS-version dependent. iOS unaffected.

summary: Occasional duplicate webhook deliveries to customer endpoints
description: Some outbound webhooks are delivered more than once. Customers ask for idempotency keys on the payload.

summary: SSO session expires earlier than the configured lifetime for Okta-federated users
description: Okta-federated users are forced to re-authenticate well before the configured session lifetime. Scoped to Okta IdP configurations; affected users can always log back in successfully.

summary: Newly invited members not searchable until the following day
description: Members created via invite do not appear in search results until the next day's index build. Scoped to newly created accounts; existing members' search entries update normally on profile changes.

summary: Password-reset emails delayed up to 30 minutes during peak hours
description: Reset emails queue behind bulk notification sends during morning peak; users request multiple resets, invalidating earlier tokens.

summary: Rescheduled sessions show the old time in Outlook calendar invites
description: After a session is rescheduled, the updated invite renders correctly in Google Calendar but Outlook continues to show the original time. Suspected ICS sequence-number handling.

summary: Profile photo upload fails for images over 8MB with a generic error
description: Uploads over 8MB fail with 'Something went wrong' instead of a size hint. No client-side validation or resize.

summary: iOS app logs users out after an iOS system update
description: Members report being signed out of the iOS app after applying an OS update; session keychain entry appears invalidated. Re-login succeeds.
CSMs and customer admins want a Slack ping when an account crosses an at-risk threshold.

summary: SCIM support for automated user deprovisioning
description: Enterprise customers want SCIM so departures deactivate automatically from the IdP instead of manual admin removal.

summary: Export team engagement summary as PDF from the manager dashboard
description: Managers want a one-click PDF of the team engagement view for leadership readouts.

summary: Bulk CSV export of the member roster
description: Admins can export the full member roster as CSV in one action. Shipped in release 4.3 (2026-06-10): Admin panel > Members > 'Export all (CSV)'.

summary: Dark mode for the mobile app
description: System-follow and manual dark mode. Shipped in release 4.2 (2026-05-14): Settings > Appearance.
Admin-visible login history (user, timestamp, IdP, IP). Shipped in release 4.1 (2026-04-20): Admin > Security > Login History.
